claim_boundary: One-case opened-source association-oracle competence control on single_lift_cloth. It can reject or admit a later automatic-query source study, but cannot establish deployability, independent transfer, Bayesian calibration, or state of the art.
question: Can direct two-frame correspondence from a PhysTwin material render to the simultaneous real prefix image recover selected material identities more accurately than the physical carrier and the frozen strict CoTracker3 comparator?

case.name: single_lift_cloth
case.identity_source: frame-zero manual world positions already used by the frozen TAPIP3D/SpatialTrackerV2 association-oracle source controls
case.identity_use: prediction receives only the nine frame-zero positions; the later manual trajectory remains unavailable until the prediction is sealed

candidate.pairing: independent two-frame pair [PhysTwin rendered RGB at t, real RGB at t] for each allowed frame and camera
candidate.reverse_cycle: a second [real RGB at t, PhysTwin rendered RGB at t] pass must return the proposed target pixel to the material-render source pixel
candidate.physical_material_query: nearest physical graph node at frame zero, maximum association distance 0.005 m
candidate.world_observation: residual-independent robust support followed by calibrated multiview ray triangulation
candidate.material_anchor: frame-zero oracle position plus triangulated displacement relative to its associated physical graph-node render

correlation_and_covariance.duplicate_camera_policy: camera poses identical within 1e-9 m and 1e-9 rotation units form one evidence group; only the highest-quality member remains
correlation_and_covariance.unknown_cross_view_correlation: per-camera information is averaged in a covariance-intersection-style update rather than summed as independent evidence
correlation_and_covariance.calibration_claim: conditional covariance diagnostic only; this one-case control cannot establish calibration

comparators_opened_only_after_prediction.physical: frame-zero oracle position plus the selected physical graph-node displacement

cotracker3.scoring: candidate and comparator use exact shared material identity-frame support

comparators_opened_only_after_prediction.target: released manual identity trajectory at frames 114 through 120

competence_gate.pass_action: Freeze the interface, then preregister a source-only automatic graph-query and guarded Bayesian assimilation study without reusing the nine manual identities.
competence_gate.fail_action: Stop this rendered-to-real AllTracker interface without tuning frames, cameras, identities, tracker settings, support thresholds, covariance scales, anchoring, or gates.

forbidden: running the predictor before this protocol is committed with status locked-before-prediction
reading the later manual trajectory or CoTracker3 comparator before the prediction archive and report are hash-sealed
reading RGB, masks, point clouds, or outcomes at or after frame 121
changing frames, cameras, identities, tracker settings, association tolerance, support thresholds, covariance scales, anchoring, comparators, or gates after lock
describing an association-oracle competence pass as a deployable method, independent transfer, Bayesian calibration, or state of the art
opening, inspecting, modifying, or rerunning any held-v8 target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifact
